input_model.evidence: Pinned nsIFormControl.h enumerators, InputButton 129 through InputRange 148; initial 147 was rejected by native-image checks.

frame.eligibility: Call actual methods for effective appearance and author-style eligibility. A raw auto appearance differs from the effective Range appearance.

appearance.evidence: DoDrawWidgetBackground jump table at 0x12bc2dc, appearance 19 to branch 0x6a600e4, PaintRange call at 0x6a6011c to 0x6a77008.

decimal.setter_argument: Nontrivial by-value Decimal passed by address in x1
decimal.ownership: Opaque engine model data; call actual conversions without copying Decimal math or validation.

pointer.ownership: Retain original Start/Finish/CancelRangeThumbDrag for capture, focus baseline, rollback and trusted events. Replace only point-to-value with actual NSSlider results. Use engine coordinates and wait for real native release; no knob/track geometry copied.

keyboard.ownership: Use existing logical-key/focus transport. Native actions call the real engine setter/change path. Unhandled native keys return through the original engine path; gesture cancellation retains original application rollback.

interfaces.lifetime: Existing frame destruction, freeze/inactivity, renderer-owned eventfd and kernel credentials/pidfd cleanup. Release unsupported style, size, aspect/orientation and helper failures.

guards: Launcher checks exact executable/libxul SHA256. Adapter checks exact libxul ELF build ID and pinned-ranges.h prologues before any activation.
limitations: Exact ARM64 Firefox ESR build only; fixed integer CSS sizes at scale 1.
Native model shape must match engine orientation. Automatic sizing, noncanonical aspect ratios, transformed/scaled output and broader styles remain open.

Default step 1, sparse aligned step 1, step any, nonzero continuous domains, disabled, vertical and equal-endpoint models are tested. Nonzero step bases, fractional/discrete steps and unaligned endpoints need broader qualification.
Datalist tick labels, touch/wheel/accessibility, broader commands and full browser application interfaces remain open. Reversed min/max retains engine fallback.
